typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{Lead ID} as string,
		{Customer ID} as string,
		{Event ID} as string,
		Title as string,
		{First Name} as string,
		{Middle Initial} as string,
		{Last Name} as string,
		Suffix as string,
		Gender as string,
		Birthdate as string,
		{Address 1} as string,
		{Address 2} as string,
		City as string,
		State as string,
		Zip as string,
		County as string,
		Phone as string,
		{Do Not Call} as string,
		{Email Address} as string,
		{Email Opt Out} as string,
		{Toll Free Number Called} as string,
		{Time of Call} as string,
		{Date of Call} as string,
		{Call Disposition} as string,
		{Plan Effective Date} as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/MEDICAID_REFERRAL*']) ~> source1
source(output(
		RecordTypeId as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/med_referral_record_type_id.csv']) ~> RecordTypeId
Select1, RecordTypeId join(1 == 1,
	joinType:'left',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'right')~> Join1
DerivedColumn1 select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Lead_ID__c = {Lead ID},
		Customer_Agility_Id__c = {Customer ID},
		Promo_ID__c = {Event ID},
		Salutation__c = Title,
		First_Name__c = {First Name},
		Middle_Name__c = {Middle Initial},
		Last_Name__c = {Last Name},
		Suffix__c = Suffix,
		Gender__c,
		Birthdate__c,
		Other_Street_1__c = {Address 1},
		Other_Street_2__c = {Address 2},
		Other_City__c = City,
		Other_State__c = State,
		Other_Postal_Code__c = Zip,
		County__c = County,
		Home_Phone__c = Phone,
		Do_Not_Call__c = {Do Not Call},
		Email__c = {Email Address},
		HasOptedOutOfEmail__c,
		Toll_Free_Number_Called__c = {Toll Free Number Called},
		Call_Time__c = {Time of Call},
		Call_Date__c = {Date of Call},
		Call_Disposition__c = {Call Disposition},
		Plan_Effective_Date__c = {Plan Effective Date}
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
ConditionalSplit1@Insert derive(Birthdate__c = coalesce(toString(toTimestamp(Birthdate, 'yyyyMMdd')), Birthdate),
		Gender__c = iif(Gender=="M","Male",iif(Gender=="F","Female",toString(null()))),
		HasOptedOutOfEmail__c = toBoolean(lower({Email Opt Out})),
		{Do Not Call} = toBoolean(lower({Do Not Call}))) ~> DerivedColumn1
source1 derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> AddADFID
AddADFID split(isNull({Lead ID})||isNull({Event ID})||isNull({First Name})||isNull({Last Name})||isNull(Gender)||isNull(Birthdate)||isNull({Address 1})||isNull(State)||isNull(Zip)||isNull(Phone)||isNull({Email Address}),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(Reject, Insert)
ConditionalSplit1@Reject derive(REJECT_REASON = concat('ADF:Field contain NULL value: ',
 iif(isNull({Lead ID}), '{Lead ID} ', ''),
 iif(isNull({Event ID}), '{Event ID} ', ''),
   iif(isNull({First Name}), '{First Name} ', ''),
     iif(isNull({Last Name}), '{Last Name} ', ''),
       iif(isNull(Gender), 'Gender ', ''),
         iif(isNull(Birthdate), 'Birthdate ', ''),
           iif(isNull({Address 1}), '{Address 1} ', ''),
             iif(isNull(City), 'City ', ''),
               iif(isNull(State), 'State ', ''),
                 iif(isNull(Zip), 'Zip ', ''),
                   iif(isNull(Phone), 'Phone ', ''),
                     iif(isNull({Email Address}), '{Email Address} ', ''))) ~> RejectReason
RejectReason select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
Join1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['MEDICAID_REFERRAL_Staging_Inbound_Campaign__c.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toInsert
AddADFID sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['MEDICAID_REFERRAL_raw.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> curatedRaw
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['MEDICAID_REFERERRAL_source_reject.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toReject
